children: Turkey's foreign trade deficit dropped by 11.4% year-on-year in October to $6.7 billion, Trade Minister Omer Bolat said on Tuesday.
Exports rose by 8.1% year-on-year to $25.9 billion and imports rose 3.4% to $32.58 billion in October, data from the Trade Ministry showed.
Turkey's foreign trade deficit widened 3.9% in January–October to $77.67 billion, data also showed.
